original: K22-O1 'after the close action, the editor is no longer shown'; M0L oracle input = visibility of an inferred editor-surface locator
user_intent: the user ends editing of this note by the close action; the note is then saved without any save action
retained_obligation: after the close action, no visible editable control is still presenting the entered note (title/content) as an active editing interface; an outer shell or a new-note entry may remain. If the editor was a modal surface, that surface must be gone or no longer the active editor.
verification: observation returns, for every visible editable control (input/textarea/contenteditable/role=textbox), whether its value contains the entered title or content; plus whether the bound editor element is still attached+visible. Judgment: closed iff no such control remains visible and editable.
affected_units: all keep REQ-2.2 and REQ-4.1 units (K22-O1 everywhere, K41-P1 prerequisite)
reason: plan §3.2: an inferred ancestor's visibility is not the obligation; Cpilot-keep showed the binding can point at the wrong surface

original: close action may be named Close/Done/Close editor/× (S1 R-NAME)
retained_obligation: the dismiss action must belong to the note editor itself (not to a nested chooser/menu/dialog) and must not be a save action; an action named Done is acceptable only when it is the editor's own dismiss action
verification: operation log records the control, its owning surface and that no nested surface was open at click time
reason: Cpilot-keep: 'Done' of the nested label chooser was clicked as the editor close

original: R1: certifier checklist included API corroboration (exactly one stored note)
user_intent: one note is created and visible
retained_obligation: K22-O2 is UI-only (exactly one visible note record with the isolated title). Storage persistence is covered by K22-O6 (reload). Optional read-only API count is recorded as supporting evidence only and never replaces UI evidence.
verification: UI note records; API dump recorded as evidence

original: 'Suggested filters'(region); panel visibly identifiable as suggested filters (heading or accessible name with that meaning)
user_intent: on focusing search the user is offered filters to narrow the search
retained_obligation: on focus a visible panel appears that offers filter choices and is identified as such by a heading/accessible name with filter/suggestion meaning (e.g. 'Suggested filters', 'Filter by label', 'Labels' as a heading of filter choices next to the search box). R2/R3: 'Filter by label' panels accepted.
verification: panel heading/name text + list of offered choices + screenshot

original: prerequisite failure reported with P id
retained_obligation: a prerequisite failure (note/label creation, book/page creation) makes the target obligations NOT_REACHED; it is never reported as a failure of the search/page-opening obligation. Unit result is REQUIREMENT_FAIL only if the prerequisite failure itself is independently confirmed as a business failure of a required flow; otherwise ADAPTATION_UNKNOWN.
verification: per-obligation status list in result record

original: fields have associated accessible names (ROOT REQ-2)
user_intent: the user can identify each field
retained_obligation: a field is identified by its associated label text. Descriptive hint text inside the label element that is also referenced by aria-describedby is description, not name (e.g. Dpilot 'Tags' + hint). No requirement on exact accessible-name string.
verification: binding audit records label text, description text and how the field was matched

user_intent: tick the label for the note
retained_obligation: a checkable option is operable if it or its associated visible label is visible (custom checkbox skins hide the native input); after the action the option must report checked state.
verification: operation log: control, how operated (native check / label click), checked state before/after
